newsitem.title: USA: Most NYMEX natgas ends down, Aug. expires in range.
newsitem.headline: Most NYMEX natgas ends down, Aug. expires in range.

text.p: NYMEX Henry Hub natgas futures mostly ended lower Tuesday in a moderate session, with August expiring down slightly but still holding the recent technical range, industry sources said.
August expired 2.2 cents lower at $2.161 per million British thermal units. September closed down 3.8 cents at $2.113. Most others ended one-half to 3.4 cents lower.

"They went looking for (buy) stops (in August) above the triple top at $2.185 and there was nothing there but good selling, so we drifted back to $2.16," said one Midwest trader, noting cooling loads in Texas were still pretty heavy but demand in the East and Midwest dried up this week with the mild weather.

While most agreed there was little conviction about price direction now, some said the market could come under pressure later next month without another sustained heat wave to boost demand or a Gulf hurricane to cut supply.
Cooler weather has arrived in the East and Midwest and is expected to continue through the week, with a slight warm up forecast for the weekend.

With August now off the board, chart traders turned their attention to September, where support was seen at $2.08 and then at last week's low of $2.045. Resistance was pegged first at the double top at $2.16 and then at recent $2.20 high.
In the cash Tuesday, Gulf Coast prices firmed a few cents to near the $2.20 level. Midcon pipes were up slightly to the $2.10-11 area. New York city gate gas was little changed in the low-$2.40s.
Injection estimates for Wednesday's weekly AGA storage report range from 55 bcf to 90 bcf. For the same week last year, stocks rose 81 bcf.
The NYMEX Henry Hub 12-month strip fell 2.2 cents to $2.199.

On the KCBT, August finished 0.8 cent higher at $2.118, while deferreds ended unchanged to down two cents. The East/West spread narrowed by three cents to 4.3 cents (NYMEX premium). KCBT said 687 contracts traded, down from Monday's total of 965.
KCBT August natgas futures expire Wednesday, July 30.
